installation_scope: Workspace extension sources and bundled assets; native undo/redo replay recovery, independent observer cameras and save isolation, missing defect helper tolerance and retryable cleanup, transactional shared display mesh binding.
validation_scope: Five installed-package regressions pass in independent Blender processes: replay undo/redo and deleted-scene cleanup, native observer camera switching and save/save-failure recovery, deleted defect resources and close retry, blade-model transaction protection, and 20 shared-context model switches after leaving reconstruction. Source suites and source save/reopen evidence have separate payload identities. Fresh daily-profile process loads the formal rootkink scene without saving and verifies all nine blades move with synchronized replay readout.
source_host_scope: Selected suites may overlap; counts are not a distinct-test total. Host checks do not import the installed Blender extension.
limits: Scripted native-window checks do not cover physical mouse interaction or the existing user window. No whole-frontend regression, complete playback/FPS benchmark, long-term memory stability, world-axis camera stabilization or scientific acceptance claim. One source test requires undistributed original VTP and is skipped.
activation_requirement: Restart Blender after replacing the installed extension; source synchronization does not reload a running process.
